id: title:DanielVisca:gate the facet rail on the metrics flag

observations.behavior: Replaces a dedicated feature flag METRICS_FACET_RAIL with the broader product-level flag METRICS.
observations.posthog_connection: This removes an unnecessary gating layer; users no longer need a separate opt-in for this UI component if they have access to the metrics product.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that the facet rail toggle is shown or hidden based on the parent METRICS flag state rather than its own removed flag.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against accidental re-introduction of independent control and documents expected behavior relative to the main product switch.

observations.code_quote: METRICS_FACET_RAIL: 'metrics-facet-rail', // owner: #team-apm — gates the facet rail (faceted filter sidebar) in the metrics viewer
observations.behavior: Deletes the definition of the METRICS_FACET_RAIL constant from the shared FEATURE_FLAGS list, removing it as a billable or independently gated capability.
observations.posthog_connection: Aligns configuration and implementation by removing support for a previously advertised but now consolidated feature gate.

observations.limitations: The removal could potentially break workflows relying on fine-grained permissioning where only the facet rail should be available without full Metrics access. The PR does not show an alternative guard or migration path; it assumes this dependency was unnecessary.

review.limitations: The removal could potentially break workflows relying on fine-grained permissioning where only the facet rail should be available without full Metrics access. The PR does not show an alternative guard or migration path; it assumes this dependency was unnecessary.
review.reason: This change removes a redundant gating layer while adding corresponding checks and documentation. It represents a bounded correctness improvement and cleanup rather than a systemic architectural shift or broad new capability.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's internal feature management and billing alignment. Removing unused flags reduces maintenance overhead and prevents potential inconsistencies between what is billed/gated versus implemented.
review.uncertainty: Without release notes or issue context, we cannot know if there were edge cases requiring independent control over the facet rail that are no longer supported.
